topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: In this town, a transfer's as common as rain on a Friday night, but there’s always more to the story. Eddie från Accounts, they say, is moving to Sales. Fresh start, they whisper, like it’s the answer to everything. Maybe it is, for the innocent. But I've seen the crosswires and the double-crosses, the way a guy's career can hinge on more than just the numbers in the books. I'll be keeping an eye on Eddie, not to say I trust the game, but because sometimes, the only way to know what’s real is to watch the players when the stakes change. This city, it’s a chessboard, and every move is worth a closer look.
